state.seed_assertion: A DPIA must assess the origin, nature, particularity and gravity of risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects.

sentences.1: The measures and safeguards provided to protect the rights and freedoms of data subjects under the GDPR;
sentences.2: A data protection impact assessment must include an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.3: (c)an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects referred to in paragraph 1
sentences.4: Controllers must conduct a data protection impact assessment before processing when the processing is likely to result in high risk to rights and freedoms, particularly when using new technologies and considering the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing.
sentences.5: Where a type of processing in particular using new technologies, and taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing, is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall, prior to the processing, carry out an assessment of the impact of the envisaged processing operations on the protection of personal data.
sentences.6: A Data Protection Impact Assessment must be conducted when a type of processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.7: Article 35(1) says that you must do a DPIA where a type of processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals
sentences.8: A DPIA must contain an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
